neighbours.label: The word family serious / seriously / Seriously (any use), vs synonyms in the same slot
fire: The kids finished the puzzle in ten minutes. Seriously, it was impressive.
Doctors said the burns were serious but not life-threatening.
She is seriously thinking about moving to Lisbon.
The flood caused serious damage to the old bridge.
He has never taken his studies seriously.
We need a serious talk about the budget.
That cake was amazing. Seriously, give me the recipe.
The coach is seriously worried about the injuries.
quiet: The kids finished the puzzle in ten minutes. Really, it was impressive.
Doctors said the burns were painful but not life-threatening.
She is actually thinking about moving to Lisbon.
The flood caused heavy damage to the old bridge.
He has never cared much about his studies.
We need a long talk about the budget.
That cake was amazing. Please, give me the recipe.
The coach is quite worried about the injuries.
